newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares edge up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares edge up in light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares edged up in light trade on Tuesday, the Lithuanian National Stock Exchange said.
Overall central market volume was only 989,000 litas while the group A index rose slightly by 8.59 points to 1439.13.
The group A index tracks the central market's 33 most active listings.
Hermis bank, one of the country's largest commercial banks, saw its shares rise to 146 litas from 142 litas in trade worth 249,000 litas.
Bloc trades worth 163,500 litas were also made on Tuesday while volume on the secondary T-bill market reached over 4.6 million litas.
